newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian shares drops at end of weekly trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian shares drops at end of weekly trade.

text.p: Jordanian stock fell 0.26 percent at end of weekly trade on Wednesday in large volume propelled by bloc sales in two rarely traded insurance stocks, dealers said.

The official Amman Financial Market (AFM) index shed 0.40 points to 155.02 points in high turnover of 1,315,075 dinars ($1,857,000), dominated by two large bloc deals in Jordan French Insurance and Al-Nisr Al-Arabi Company.
Dealers say small investor interest, in the absence of major institutional and outside purchases, is now focusing on a handful of blue chips expected to report healthy 1996 earnings.

Renewed uncertainty over the fate of Middle East peace adds to investor worries about the fate of $120 million worth of orders won by Jordanian firms under the U.N. "oil-for food" deal because of approval delays by the sanctions committee.
Many industrial firms, especially drug manufacturers, hope Iraq exports will boost performance and utilise idle capacity
Some recent buying has been motivated by expectations Iraq orders will produce improved 1997 results.
Growing doubts about the government's seriousness in implementing its privatisation pledge has also kept some investors on the sidelines this week, dealers say.
Jordan Cement Factories continued to draw investor interest with a 0.03 dinar rise to 3.53 dinars in trade worth 94,167 dinars.
But selling pressure on leading Arab Bank sent the stock 2.500 dinars lower to 259.50 dinars in minimal trade worth 72,770 dinars, helping drag the market lower.
Two firms which saw some limited foreign investor interest this week, Arab Potash Company and Jordan National Bank, were unchanged at 6.10 dinars and 1.96 dinars respectively.
Only four stocks rose against 13 loser stocks on Wednesday, while eighteen traded but closed unchanged.
The private Pearl Index of the 45 most-traded shares on the exchange shed 0.26 percent to 81.22 points, 2.60 percent down from the start of the year.
